name: 45 in 1 Cordless Electric Screwdriver with Bits Holder with LED Light Screwdriver, Rechargeable Screwdriver Tools Kit, Wireless Screwdriver Drill Machine with Reversible Function
description:
The 45-in-1 Cordless Electric Screwdriver Kit is a complete and versatile tool set designed for both professionals and DIY enthusiasts. Whether you’re assembling furniture, repairing gadgets, or tackling home improvement projects, this rechargeable screwdriver delivers power, precision, and convenience.

Key Features:

🔧 Versatile 45-Piece Set: Comes with 45 essential components, including multiple screwdriver bits and accessories—perfect for all your drilling and fastening needs.

🔋 Rechargeable & Cordless: Built-in rechargeable battery ensures long-lasting performance without the hassle of frequent replacements. The cordless design gives you maximum freedom and flexibility.

🔁 Reversible Function: Features a bidirectional button for easy switching between clockwise and counterclockwise rotation, providing total control for tightening or loosening screws.

💡 Built-in LED Light: Integrated LED lighting brightens your workspace, making it easier to work in dark or confined areas.

⚙️ Keyless Chuck Technology: Quickly and easily change bits with the keyless chuck, saving time and boosting efficiency.

Package Includes:

1 × Cordless Electric Screwdriver

45 × Assorted Bits and Accessories

1 × Bits Holder

1 × Charging Cable

1 × User Manual
